header.Title (Target): Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa

text.S1: There was once a little girl whose father and mother loved her so dearly they thought nothing too good for her. Her mother made her the prettiest little dresses; Her mother also made for her a little cloak and hood from red cloth, and the little girl looked so pretty in them that her mother called her Little Red Riding-Hood.

text.T1: Nako yen͂wi nekuna ni kasizana kene kalatiwa ahulu ki bondatakona ni boma kona kama yebutuku mi bakahupulela zende. Boma kona bakalukela ndelesi yende luli. Boma kona hape bakalukela kabaki ni kakuwani - fa lisila lelifibelu, mi kasizana ka bonahala hande kuli boma kona baka la kuka biza kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa.
text.T2: Nako yen͂wi nekuna ni kasizana kane kalatiwa hahulu ki bo ndataakona ni bo maakona kanama yebutuku mi bahupula kuli neka sina zende hahulu. Bo maakona bakalukela tundelesi totunde hahulu kakufitisisa luli. Bo maakona hape bakalukela kabaki ni kakuwani fa lisila lelifubelu, kacwalo kasizana kabonahala kukaba hande mwa litino zewo kuli mane bo maakona bakala kukabiza kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa.

text.S1: Little Red Riding-Hood had a grandmother who was so old that sometimes she lay in bed all day and felt too weak to get up.
text.S2: Little Red Riding-Hood had a grandmother who was so old that sometimes she lay in bed all day and felt too weak to get up.
text.T1: Kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa neka nani bokuku bakona bene basupezi ahulu kuli neba kona kulobala fa mumbeta mushihali kaufela ni kuikutwa kulonda kuli bazuhe.
text.T2: Kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa nekana ni bo kukwaakona bane basupezi hahulu kuli neba kona kulobala fa mumbeta musihali kaufela ni kuikutwa kufokola kuli bazuhe

text.S1: One day the mother called the little girl to her and said, “My child, I have put a pat of butter and some fresh eggs and a cornbread in this basket. Take it and carry it to your grandmother. Run along quickly, and do not loiter nor stop to talk to anyone along the way, for I want you to get back before the afternoon is late.” “Yes, dear mother,” said the little girl, and she took the basket in her hand and set out for her grandmother’s house.

text.T1: Kazazi lelin͂wi bomakona kasizana bakabiza mi bali kukona, “mwanaka, ni beile siemba sa lubibi lolukambile, mai, ni sinkwa mwa sizuma se. usinge usishimbe wise kubo kukukwa hao ba basali. Mata kapili, mi usike wa potoloha-potoloha kapa kuyema kwambola ni mutu mwa nzila nibata kuli ukute kanako musiyali wa manzibwana usika fela kale.
text.T2: Kazazi lelin͂wi bo maakona kasizana bakabizeza kubona bali, “Mwanaaka, nibeile siemba sa mbata, mai amanca ni sinkwa sesi pumakilwe mwa sizuma se. Siinge usishimbe wise ku bo kukwaahao ba basali. Mata kapili, mi usike wafuwafuwa kapa kuyema ni kwambola ni mutu mwa nzila kakuli nibata kuli ukute kanako musihali wa manzibwana usika fela kale.” “Eni, bo ma babalateha,” kwaalaba kasizana. Kasizana ki haka nanula sizuma mwa lizoho ni kuliba kwa ndu ya bo kukwaakona ba basali.

text.S1: Presently she heard feet padding along the path, and the old gray hyena came trotting by. “Good-day, Red Riding-Hood,” said the hyena. “Good-day,” answered the child. “And where are you going this fine bright day with your basket on your arm?” “Oh, I am going to my grandmother’s house. She is so old that sometimes she lies in bed and cannot get up, and I am taking her some butter and some fresh eggs and some cornbread.”
text.S2: Presently she heard feet padding along the path, and the old gray hyena came trotting by. “Good-day, Red Riding-Hood,” said the hyena. “Good-day,” answered the child. “And where are you going this fine bright day with your basket on your arm?” “Oh, I am going to my grandmother’s house. She is so old that sometimes she lies in bed and cannot get up, and I am taking her some butter and some fresh eggs and some cornbread.”
text.T1: Mwanako yekuswani autwa misindo ya mahutu mwa nzila, neli sitongwani sesiseta sa mucembele sene simumatela. “ki musihali, kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa,” kwa bulela sitongwani. “Ki musihali,” kwa alaba kanana “cwale uya kai ni lizazi lelilila cwana ni sizuma mwa lizoho? “Ho, niya kwa ndu ya bokuku. Ki macembele ahulu kuli fokumwi habalobezi fa mumbeta bapalelwa kuzuha, nibaiseza lubibi lolukambile, mai ni sinkwa.”
text.T2: Cwanoñu kasizana kautwa misindo ya mahutu mwa nzila. Neeli sitongwani sa mucembele sesiseta sene simusheshelela. Ki musihali, kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa,” sitongwani samulekula. “Ki musihali,” kasizana ka alaba. “Cwale uya kai mwa lizazi lelinyandima cwana, ni sizuma mwa lizoho?” “Oho! Niya kwa ndu ya bo kuku. Ki macembele hahulu kuli fokuñwi haba lobezi fa mumbeta bapalelwa kuzuha, cwale niba iseza kwateñi mbata, mai amanca ni sinkwa.”

text.S1: “And where does your grandmother live?” the hyena asked. “She lives beyond the woods in a little white house with a thatched roof and green blinds, the path runs straight there.” The hyena had now learned all he cared to know. He bade Red Riding-Hood good-by and trotted on briskly. As soon as he came into the woods where Red Riding-Hood could not see him he began to gallop. On and on he galloped as fast as he could, for he was anxious to get to the little white house with the thatched roof and the green blinds before Red Riding-Hood did.

Bapila kwabuse bwa mushitu mwa kandu ka kasweu ka situwa sa kululela ka bucwani, nzila imata kuliba kwateni” sitongwani nese situtile zene sibata kuziba. Sitongwani sa laeza kasizana Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa ni kusheshela ka maata luli. Kapili-kapili sakena mushitu moo kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa nekasika sibona ni kumata kabube. Kakuswalelela samata kapili-pili ka monesikonela, pilaelo neli ya kuyo fita kwa kandu ka mucembele kakasweu ni situwa se silulezwi pili kasizana ka sikafita kale.
text.T2: “Bo kukwaahao bapila kai?” sitongwani sabuza. “Bapila kwabuse bwa mushitu, mwa kandu kakasweu ka situwa sesi lulezwi ka bucwañi ni masila a matala fa mahaulo. Nzila imata kuliba kwateñi.” Sitongwani cwale nese siitutile zene sibata kuziba. Salaeza kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa ni kusheshela ka maata luli. text.S1: In the depths of the woods, Little Red Riding-Hood’s grandmother was busy at work. She saw the old hyena go by, and she wondered what he was after. “He’s up to some mischief or other, and that is for sure,” said the grandmother. And she followed on after the hyena to see what he was going to do.

text.T1: Fahala mushitu, bo ku kwahae kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa nebapateile kusebeza. Ba bona sitongwani sa mucembele inge sifita babilaela kuli nesi batan͂i. Neli sitangu kapa zemwi, mi kinitiluli, kwa bulela mucembele. Mucembele alatela sitongwani kuli abone ze sibata kweza.
text.T2: Fahala mushitu, bo kukwaa kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa ba basali, neba patehile kusebeza. Hababona sitongwani sa mucembele inge sifita bakomoka kuli nesi batan͂i. “Sizamayela mifilifili kapa zeñwi lisili? Mi ki niti luli,” bo kukwaa kasizana babulela. mucembele. Balatelela sitongwani kuli babone zene sika eza.

text.S1: On went Mr. Hyena, and presently he came to the edge of the forest, and there stood the little white house with the thatched roof and green blinds, and the path led straight up to the door, so the hyena knew that must be where the grandmother lived. He stopped and looked all about him, for he did not want anyone to watch him. He saw no one, however, for the grandmother was still catching up to him. Then the hyena knocked at the door, rat-tat-tat!
text.S2: On went Mr. Hyena, and presently he came to the edge of the forest, and there stood the little white house with the thatched roof and green blinds, and the path led straight up to the door, so the hyena knew that must be where the grandmother lived. text.T1: Sitongwani sa zwelapili, mane sayo fita kwa mukenga wa mushitu ni kufumana kandu ka kasweu, ka situwa sesilulezwi ka bucwani ni kutitiyana, mi nzila neliba feela mwa munyako, mi sitongwani nesi zibile kuli luli kona mwa pila mucembele. Sitongwani sa yema ni kutalimisisa kacwalo nesi salati mutu ya sibona. Akuna yene siboni nihakulicwalo musali muhulu yena nasataha mwa mulawo. Cwale sitongwani sangongota fa sikwalo, ngo-ngo-ngo!
text.T2: Sitongwani sa muuna sazwelapili kuzamaya mane cwanoñu safita kwa mukulo wa mushitu ni kufumana kandu ka kasweu, ka situwa sesilulezwi ka bucwani ni masila a matala fa mahaulo, mi nzila nei liba feela fa munyako, mi kacwalo, sitongwani saziba kuli luli ki mona mwapila kukwaa kasizana. Sitongwnai sayema ni kutalimisisa kwa maneku kaufela kakuli nesi salati mutu kusibona. Hakuna mutu yene siboni. Nihakulicwalo, haili kukwaa kasizana yena nasaa sisutelela mwamulaho. Cwale sitongwani sangongota fa sikwalo, ‘ngo! ngo!-ngo!’

text.S1: Nobody answered, so he knocked again, rat-tat-tat! Still no one answered, and there was no stir within the house, though the hyena cocked his ear and listened carefully. The hyena pulled the latchstring, the latch flew up, and he pushed the door open, and slipped inside. He looked about, and there was nobody there, for the old grandmother had been feeling stronger that day, so she had dressed and had gone out to pick berries.

text.T1: Akuna yana alabile, sa kutala kungongota hape, ngo-ngo-ngo! Hape akuna yana alabile, hape nekusina sene sinyanganya mwa ndu, nihaike sitongwani nesi bapuzi mazebe asona ni kuteleza hande. Sitongwani sawoha muhala wa belebele, cwale belebele ya fasukela mwa halimu, ni kukasha sikwalo sesi kwahaluha ni kukena mwa ndu satalimisisa hande mi nekusina mutu, lizazi leo musalimuhulu naikutwile kuba ni mata, natinile nikuya kwa kunopa litolwana.
text.T2: Hakuna yanaa alabile, cwale sakutela kungongota hape, ‘ngo! ngo! ngo! Hape hakuna yanaa alabile. Hape nekusina sene sinyanganya mwa ndu, nihaike sitongwani nesi bapuzi mazebe asona ni kuteeleza hande. Sitongwani sahoha muhala wa kabelebele, cwale kabelebele kafasukela mwahalimu, sakasha sikwalo, hase sikwaluha sakena mwa ndu. Sesitalima-talima hande kono nekusina mutu kakuli zazi lewo bo kukwaa kasizana neba ikutwa kuba ni maata. Neba tinile ni kuya kwa kunopa miselo yeminyinyani.

text.S1: The old hyena hunted about until he found the grandmother’s bed gown; then he pulled it on over his big hairy body. He tied on a big ruffled cap and put the grandmother’s spectacles on his nose, and after that he crawled into bed and drew the coverlet up under his chin.

text.T1: Sitongwani sa mucembele sazuma katata kufitela sifumana ndelesi ya musali muhulu ya kulobala ni yona. Cwale saihoha ni ibundeka fa mubili wo sana wo mutuna ni bulizi. Sitongwani satamela ndelesi fa kuwani ye shangalakani ni, kunga mangilasi amusali muhulu kubeya fa ngo. Hasamulaho ni ku hohobela fa mumbeta ni kuikapesa lisila kufitisa mwa mulala.
text.T2: Sitongwani sa mucembele sazuma kataata kufitela sifumana ndelesi ya kukwaa kasizana ya kulobala ni yona. Cwale saihoha ni kui kapesa yona fa mubili wasona womutuna wa bulizi. Sitongwani satamela kwa toho kuwani yetuna yeshangalakani ni kuunga mangilasi a bo kukwaa kasizana kubeya fa ngo yasona, kasamulaho sahohobela fa mumbeta ni kuikapesa lisila kuli fitisa mwa mulala.

text.S1: It was not long before Little Red Riding-Hood came running along, and she was in a great hurry, for she had spent a long time gathering flowers. The grandmother did not see her, however, for she was asleep in the garden. The little girl ran up to the door and knocked upon it, rat-tat-tat! Then the old hyena made his voice very faint and weak like the grandmother’s.

text.T1: Nekusikafita nako ye telele kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa sekafita kataha inge ka mata mi naakufile ahulu. Neka sinyize nako yetelele ka sweli kuyanga lipalisa. Bo kukwa kona ba basali neba sikakabona kono nihakulicwalo neba ikezi fa buloko mwa simu ya miloho. Kasizana neka matile kuyo fita fa munyako ni kungongota, ngo-ngo-ngo! Sitongwani sa mucembele saalabaka linzwi leli mwatasi nika kulonda inge linzwi la musalimihulu.
text.T2: Nekusikafita nako yetelele pili kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa kataha inge kamata ka kuankufa hahulu kakuli neka sinyize nako yetelele kasweli kuyanga lipalisa. Bo kukwaa kona ba basali neba sikakabona, nihakulicwalo, neba ikezi fa buloko mwa simu ya miloho. Kasizana kamatela kwa munyako kuyongongota, ‘Ngo! Ngo! Ngo!’ Kacwalo, sitongwani sa mucembele saalaba ka linzwi leli mwataasi nika kulonda inge linzwi la bo kukwaa kasizana.

text.S1: “Who is there?” he asked. “It is I, grandmother; Little Red Riding-Hood,” answered the child. “Pull the latchstring, and lift the latch,” said the hyena. Red Riding-Hood lifted the latch and pushed the door open and went in.

text.S1: There was not much light in the room, for the hyena had pulled the curtains across the window. “I am not able to get up, dear child,” said the hyena, still in the same weak voice. “Put your basket on the table and come over here.” Red Riding-Hood did as she was told. She put the basket on the table and came over to the bedside, but as she came closer she thought her grandmother looked very strange.

text.S1: “The better to eat you!” howled the hyena, and he sprang out of bed and caught Red Riding-Hood by the cloak. The little girl cried out, but at this moment the grandmother burst open the door and rushed in. The howl had awakened her from her sleep, and just in time. She struck the hyena with such a blow to the head that it fell down dead.

text.T1: “Kihande kukuca! “kwa hona sitongwani, kona situla fa mumbeta ni kuswala kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa mwa baki yene katinile. Kasizana kalila ka kutiisa, kono ka nako yewo bo kukwaakona banata hahulu sikwalo, kusikwalula ni kukena mwahali. Koona kwa sitongwnai neku muzusize fa buloko kanako yeo. Musali muhulu a lindula sitongwnai ka libumu kwa toho mi sawa fafasi ni kushwa.
text.T2: “Ki hande kukuca!” kwañwaula sitongwani, mi satula fa mumbeta ni kuswala kasizana ka Bufubelu Bobunyinyani bwa Kasoti ka Kucobisa mwa sitino sene katinile. Kasizana kalila ka kutiisa mi cwale ki kayona nako yewo bo kukwaakona banata hahulu sikwalo, kusikwalula ni kukena mwahali kabubebe. Kuñwaula kwa sitongwnai kwamuzusa fa buloko ka nako yenyinyani feela. Bo kukwaa kasizana balindula sitongwnai ka ñindi kwa toho mi sawela fafasi ni kushwa.

text.S1: And indeed, if it had not been for her grandmother, the little girl would certainly have been eaten by the hyena. But from then on Little Red Riding-Hood was careful to obey her mother, and not to loiter on the way when she was sent on errands.
